name: rustroot
description: Rust Root — 从底层理念与思维方式理解 Rust 的课程网站（rustroot.cn / rustroot.dev）

scripts.build: npm run build:zh && npm run build:en
scripts.build:zh: node scripts/ensure-locale-astro-dir.mjs && SITE_LOCALE=zh astro build --outDir dist/zh
scripts.build:en: node scripts/ensure-locale-astro-dir.mjs && SITE_LOCALE=en astro build --outDir dist/en
